classification.difficultyReason: Isosceles trapezoid: half the base difference gives a right triangle, Pythagoras gives x, then SA.

content.prompt:
Find the surface area of this solid.
First calculate the missing length using Pythagoras’ Theorem.

answer.worked:
The two sloping sides are equal, so each horizontal offset is $\frac{26-14}{2}=6\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}x^2&=6^2+8^2\\x^2&=100\\x&=10\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
Front and back: $2\times\frac{8}{2}(26+14)=320\text{ cm}^2$.
Top: $14\times12=168\text{ cm}^2$.
Bottom: $26\times12=312\text{ cm}^2$.
Sloping sides: $2(10\times12)=240\text{ cm}^2$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Surface area}&=320+168+312+240\\\text{Surface area}&=1040\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$
